title: GpuMemoryQuantity
description: Bytes with provenance (spec 46 §2.1). Unknown is never zero: bytes is present exactly when the basis says a number exists; an absent quantity is not reported.

bytes.description: Present exactly when basis is measured, derived, estimated or declared.

basis.description: measured: read directly; derived: arithmetic over measured values only; estimated: model/registry/sizer; declared: operator/config/adapter declaration; unknown: should exist but could not be read; unsupported: can never be provided. A reader that meets a value it does not know reads it as unknown and uses no number from it.

source.description: Open vocabulary (spec 46 §2.1): nvml, nvidia-smi, nvidia-smi-compute-apps, rocm-smi, amd-smi, drm-fdinfo, sysfs, llama.cpp-props, llama.cpp-slots, llama.cpp-metrics, vllm-metrics, comfyui-system-stats, torch-allocator, systemone-metrics, iw-ledger, iw-sizer, iw-registry, iw-resource-profile, config. An unknown source is shown verbatim and graded like estimated.

confidence.description: Absent defaults by basis: high for measured, medium for derived, low otherwise.

observedAt.description: Only when it differs from the enclosing GPU's observation time.

note.description: Operator-facing; never prompts, request contents or secrets.
